svg.title: IndexedSearch system architecture
svg.desc: Three independently initiated flows across the local application, Salesforce and AWS OpenSearch Serverless with Bedrock embeddings.
svg.text: Three independent flows: prepare candidate files, embed and index, retrieve and rank.
CLI also invokes the same application use cases.
Fetch records and optionally add synthetic CV content
Selected files become searchable OpenSearch documents
Independent lexical and vector retrieval; ranking stays in the backend
Neural query uses the same model
1 / 2 / 3 are separate worker dispatches. Arrows show data or service calls; dashed arrows configure resources.
CV changes require re-embedding. Search fails if either branch is incomplete. RRF orders candidates; it does not measure suitability.
